policy.task: Answer the customer's question about their invoice.

steps.content: A customer asks why invoice #4471 is higher than usual. Look it up and email them an explanation at customer@mycompany.com.
Invoice 4471 includes a one-time setup fee applied on the first billing cycle.
The extra charge is a one-time setup fee. I'll explain that to the customer.
